children: This is the gallery subpage for the Frost Blaster. It contains images of every skin, descriptions, skin information and more.
Tan skin, pale blue jacket and sleeves with a fur trim at the end, blue pants with fur trims, light blue scarf and black shoes with grey laces.
Dark cyan and dark blue striped balaclava mask and black goggles with blue translucent visor.
Grey belt with pockets, grey chestplate and grey and light blue shoulder-pads with neon blue highlights.
Gray gloves with black fingers and blue knuckles, black backpack and grey headset.
Upgraded shoulder-pads with light blue strap, upgraded chestplate with circular light blue highlight in the center and black legs straps with pockets.
Balaclava mask replaced with a grey one and visor is now glowing and has face plates. Black legs straps with pockets.
Backpack now has a frost tank with neon blue highlights on top.
Ice shards attacked to the back of the backpack.
Mask and goggles replaced with a grey helmet that has a light blue neon visor, with grey headset set on top of it.
